sloka: चतु:शालानि शुभ्राणि शालाश्च गजवाजिनाम् ।हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधास्तोरणानि शुभानि च ॥ २.९१.३२॥
transliteration: catu:śālāni śubhrāṇi śālāśca gajavājinām ।harmyaprāsādasambādhāstoraṇāni śubhāni ca ॥ 2.91.32॥

translations.english: Bright quadrangles, stables for elephants and horses, auspicious arch ways for palaces and mansions sprang up.
